hero.subtitle: Where the ancient wisdom of Shizen meets the fertile soul of Gilan. Authentic, effortless, and deeply rooted in the earth.

philosophy.label: The Philosophy
philosophy.title:
"Nature does not hurry,
yet everything is accomplished."
philosophy.p1: Rostara is born from the concept of Shizen (自然) — naturalness without pretense. We believe that true quality comes not from forcing the land, but from listening to it. Our farming practices in the lush plains of Gilan honor the rhythm of the seasons, the flow of water, and the life of the soil.
philosophy.p2: We reject artificial acceleration. Our rice grows at its own pace, nourished by rain and river, untouched by synthetic chemicals. The result is food that carries the honest taste of nature — pure, wholesome, and full of life force.

footer.desc: Rostara; Natural Orderly Growth. Cultivating harmony through the Shizen philosophy.
